The '''''Dicer''''' was the name given to [[Eelo Begraas]]' [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]]. The elite [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] pilot customized his ship, making it incredibly maneuverable. It was also rumored to contain some prototype technology obtained by the Bothan from a job for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Begraas painted the fighter [[Color/Legends|black]], with highlights in blood red. Begraas' personal insignia of a clenched fist was also painted on either side of the cockpit.
